programmes.d: What's the typical American car of the 1960s, the symbol for American car manufacturing? For many it's either the Corvette or the Ford Mustang. On his search for these American treasures Tillmann makes a surprise discovery. Part 1 of 2.
The "F1H20 World Powerboat Championship" is the worlds' fastest boat racing championship with speeds up to 250 kp/h.
In Florida, Tillmann witnesses how Revology Cars upgrade original 1964 Ford Mustang chassis with modern technology and engines. Part 2 of 2.

programmes.t: The Dubai Police Force's Special Cars Unit
programmes.d: For the first time the Dubai Police special cars unit allows a TV crew to accompany their officers on patrol. These aren't normal police cars because this is not a normal city.
Onboard the McLaren 570 GT on the island of Tenerife

'If you own a Jeep, we're everything that you'll need' - That's what the people at ORZ Vehicles pride themselves with. By selling and assembling accessories for Jeep, they make the American off-road dream come true for European customers.

The Jaguar XF-S is supposed to put pressure on BMW, Audi and the other competitors in the business class segment. Volvo take a different approach. Their S90 is captivating due to its Scandinavian design and economical four-cylinder engines.
Once a year the American Classic, Custom and Hot Rods meet at the Street Mag Show. Not in Michigan however, but on the A3 between Wuerzburg and Erlangen in Germany.

BMW offers the X2 as a compact hipster SUV for young people. The DS 7 Crossback, on the other hand, wants to convey the French lifestyle. And Jaguar's E-Pace enters the market as a smaller version of the F-Pace.

A skidding lorry against a remote controlled family van. Thats the new story the Stunt Heroes realize on their private Autobahn. Stunt coordinator Christoph Domanskis goal: to separate the roof from the rest of the car. If the plan works out, they will create a unique stunt convertible.

With the compact SUV Velar, Range Rover attempts to reach a broader audience. Jeep relies on the tried and tested: the design of the Wrangler has remained almost the same for more than 60 years. Also: the Volvo XC60 and the Ford Edge.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.

The Mercedes Sprinter still is one of the most popular commercial vehicles. For its third generation, the brand chose to have it manufactured in Poland. Before, this iconic van shared its production line with Volkswagen's Crafter.

The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.

Porsche quits the diesel business. Hybrids such as the Cayenne E-Hybrid are expected to become their focus of attention. Also: taking the BMW X4 on tour around Spartanburg, USA. And: mountain climbing with the Volkswagen Touareg in Austria.
Monster Jam is an American monster truck series where drivers have to perform stunts and race against each other.

The ice course on Lungauring, the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 in winter training. Twelve participants in six Evos were taught the art of drifting with a four-wheel drive car. We accompanied a student on his first drifting experience.
The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top fuel dragsters that exceed speeds of roughly 300 mp/h in under 5 seconds.

James Bond still didn't have a license to kill, when this representative Russian vehicle called ZIS 110 rolled off the production line in 1949. The 110 was developed by reverse engineering a 1942 Packard Super Eight.

Rally Coromandel sends the New Zealand Rally Championship onto spectacular coastal gravel roads, where speed, precision and consistency are vital. With the title fight heating up, every stage and every second matter in this tense mid-season showdown.
The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles.

Rally Bay of Plenty serves up intense New Zealand Rally Championship action, with the leading crews chasing points on demanding gravel stages. Expect high-speed drama, technical challenges and momentum swings as the season builds toward its climax.
The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles.

The 2025 European Motocross Championship is the 37th European Motocross Championship season since it was revived in 1988. It includes 16 events and 6 different classes. It will start in Spain on 16 March and will end in Turkey on 7 September.

The International Rally of Whangarei brings the 2025 New Zealand Rally Championship to a thrilling conclusion. On world-class gravel roads, the leading crews battle for rally victory and the chance to secure the top prize in a dramatic season finale.
The FIM QuadCross World Championship (formerly EMX Quad European Championship) is the premier international competition for quad bike motocross.
The "AWDC" is a british offorad event where drivers have to tackle tight and twisty roads filled with mud und gravel.

When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

We take out the Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo for a couple of rounds

With 3.5 million units sold worldwide, the Mercedes Sprinter is one of the most popular commercial vehicles. Now in its third generation, it is more modern than ever. Thanks to numerous connectivity applications, it is intended to make fleet management easier.
At the old-timer grand prix at the Nürburgring you for example can see the Mercedes S with 160 horsepower that lead Rudolf Caracciola to victory in the 1927 opening race.

Two years after the premiere of the SLS AMG Gullwing, Mercedes introduceses an open roadster version of the model. Tuning takes a look at the roadster and meets a driver of the regular Mercedes SLS AMG who tests out his car at the Nuerburgring Nordschleife. Plus: Tuning visits the Custombike.
In this episode we focused on Phoenix Racing, the successful team from the Eifel Region that rocked the DTM.

This is what it looks like when the Stunt Heroes from Action Concept perform a long jump: A vehicle jumps at full speed over four cars, which explode one after the other. It’s a matter of precision and timing. Up-and-coming stuntwoman Tina has to prove, what she can do.
At the Nürburgring Patrick chased a 12-cylinder Aston Martin Zagato down the track. Also on the show: a Hummer, a Renault Clio and a Frenchman in a Ferrari.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.
Visitors from all over the world make their way to the Green Hell of the Nürburgring each year, including many Germans, Austrians and 5 crazy Englishmen in a taxi.
The "Ferrari Challenge Europe" is an one-make series for Ferraris with seven races across Europe.

programmes.d: In Monza, Ken Block is set to compete against Allstars from motorsport at the Monza Rally Show.

In 2011, the European Boss Hoss Rally took place in the Pullman City western town in Germany. We show the highlights of this event where nearly 160 V8 monster bikes were gathered. (Part 1 of 2)
Gearing Up shows the world's most unique motorsport events covering cars, bikes and everything else.
It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.
10 or 16 inch wheels - is this really just a question of taste? Motorvision reveals the advantages and disadvantages of the big wheel motorcycle People GT 300i, made by Kymco.
In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

Electric cars can’t be sporty? Oh yes they can – at least with the right boost. The Alpine A290 is meant to carry the brand’s racing DNA into the electric era. We’re checking whether that works and taking a look at the legendary rally history of the French manufacturer. And the VW ID.
We present to you historic image and film documents from the Porsche 550 RS Spyder. And: how the Audi Quattro shocked its competitors with its driving dynamics.

By now, Audi has sold more than 16,000 sports cars around the world. In 2010 they upped the stakes even more and introduced the Audi R8 GT. The high performance sports car is limited on 333 units and has been designed to show Audi’s expertise in the field of lightweight construction.

High-tech turbo cars from the wild 1980s are reunited at the Salzburgring race track. Also: the Lancia Beta Monte Carlo, a small Italian two-seater with mid-engine offers classic car driving pleasure at a low entry price.

Practical, not too big yet spacious and versatile – everyone wants compact cars. That’s why manufacturers offer plenty of choice. Kia has a whole lineup of new models ready to go. We take a look at the new Sportage facelift and other vehicles from the Korean brand’s numeric lineup.

The Jaguar XF-S is supposed to put pressure on BMW, Audi and co. in the business class segment. With V6 power, 380 HP output and all-wheel drive it wants to teach the German top dogs the true meaning of the word fear. Volvo takes a different approach.

The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster provides space for 5 fresh air fans. Also: Le Jog, the toughest classic car rally in Europe. A German women's team takes on the challenge in their VW Iltis. And: a charming oldie, the 1919 Wolseley Stellite.
The company Remus was founded more than 20 years ago and is located near Graz, Austria. On 36,000 square meters sport exhaust systems for many different cars and motorcycles are manufactured.

With the M3, BMW brought race car technology to the road. In addition: 120 years of Mercedes-Benz motorsports history. And: turbo power in the DTM. The Ford Sierra RS Cosworth taught its racing competition the meaning of fear.
Ther are million ways to destroy a car: Crashes, flips and jumps. We show the highlights of this seasons car stunts.

Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.
The "Ferrari Challenge Europe" is an one-make series for Ferraris with seven races across Europe.
Advantage through Technology on rally tracks. The Audi Quattro shocks opponents.
With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

The Indy 500 is one of the most spectacular racing events in the world. More than 400.000 spectators watch this mixture of show and motorsports competition at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway each year. We take a look back at the 1994 Indy 500.

Since its premiere in 1970 the Deutsche Rallye Meisterschaft has been one of the most popular motorsports series. In the 1983 competition Opel's Manta, Kadett and Ascona sports models celebrated exceptional successes.

Australian Circuit Boat Racing offers high-speed thrills on the water, where precision and speed decide intense races on demanding courses. Spectacular competitions captivate motorsport fans across Australia.

In 1985 Audi made their impressive mark in motorsports with the Quattro. With its 4x4 drive this model impressed the audience and shocked the competition alike and ushered in a new era in rally sports.

Australian Circuit Boat Racing offers high-speed thrills on the water, where precision and speed decide intense races on demanding courses. Spectacular competitions captivate motorsport fans across Australia.

After more than 20 years of abstinence Mercedes-Benz return to the Grand Prix circuit in 1954. With a lot of ambition, the company's advanced engineering and some of the best drivers in the world the Mercedes team aimed for the championship.

In the late fifties in America, the first Formula V racers were produced. The goal: Affordable motor sport for everyone. programmes.t: Ken Block at the Monza Rallye Show
programmes.d: In Monza, Ken Block is set to compete against Allstars from motorsport at the Monza Rally Show.
The IAA in Frankfurt is the largest motor show in the world. More than 900 exhibitors present their new products in 11 halls and on 14 outdoor areas. Here you can marvel at tomorrow's trends today.
The "F1H20 World Powerboat Championship" is the worlds' fastest boat racing championship with speeds up to 250 kp/h.
The tuning forge SKN from Benstorf is organising a Dyno Day for the second time. Also: Lorinser refines the Mercedes E 500 Coupé. And: an invitation to Raeder Motorsport.

All-Wheel drive is not just for off-road adventures. The new Mercedes E-Class T-Model sends its power to all four wheels to ensure abnormal acceleration and the best dynamic handling in bends. Paired with the output of 333 hp, the AMG version becomes a powerful estate wagon.
Patrick Simon tests the Aston Martin Zagato on the Grand Prix circuit. Also: Renault Megane Sport vs. Golf GTI Edition 35. And: the Porsche 997 and 994 on the Nordschleife.

In Ron's Garage antique scrap piles from the desert get turned into rolling pieces of art in accordance with customer specifications. If you want to cross the desert, Mercedes has the perfect vehicle.
Once a year, Las Vegas hosts the largest car and tuning trade show in the world - the SEMA Show. We show the highlights from hot rods to custom cars.
The Stunt Heroes having fun on a hudge industrial Area. Here it comes to the showdown between man and machine - Stuntman against BMW 3.
The car tuner Lorinser looks back on more than 30 years of experience in tuning Mercedes Benz cars. Also: aeroplane vs. Porsche GT3. And: in an Aston Martin on the Nordschleife.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.
The Essen Motor Show is the event for automobile and motor sports enthusiasts. Over 300,000 visitors flock here every year and bring the hallowed halls to a boil.

The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.

Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

High winds force a shortened course as drivers tackle the mountain. GT4 Trophy by Yokohama and Time Attack One classes push for top times in a demanding run where changing conditions and altitude make every second count.

Once a year the noblest and rarest classic cars are gathered at one location: the Concorso d' Eleganza Villa d'Este at Lake Como about 50 kilometers north of Arese. Proud owners present their vintage vehicles from long forgotten decades.
The Belcar Endurance Championship is the top-tier national endurance racing championship in Belgium. The series is sanctioned by the Royal Automobile Club of Belgium and run by Circuit Zolder.
Exhibition and Open Wheel classes tackle a shortened course due to high winds, featuring Honda’s hydrogen-powered CR-V debut and Fred Veach’s emotional farewell run on the mountain.
1990 saw the launch of the inaugural season of the fastest brand trophy in the world: the Porsche Carrera Cup.

It's the fastest art collection in the world. Designed by famous artists like Andy Warhol, Roy Liechtenstein, Frank Stella or Jeef Koons, these racing artworks have been used by BMW in Le Mans for years.

The Open Division tackles a shortened course due to high winds, featuring rookie runs, Lonni Unser’s charge, J.R. Hildebrand’s NASCAR stock car, a Michèle Mouton tribute, and Ford’s radical electric Mustang Mach-E.

Vive la difference: Their design is always unusual, their comfort is always extraordinary, and their ideas are often avant-garde: Of course we’re talking about the cars from Renault. With the help of the Dauphine, Renault is contributing to the economic miracle.
The Unlimited Division features exotic prototypes, rookie standouts, Robin Shute in a brutal Camaro, and a fierce Nova Proto showdown between Diego De Gasperi and Simone Faggioli.
